main_text.p: אותיאום Confestim, Mox, Statim: ex [illegible, ~4 letters].
אחד Unus. Item Numerus singularis. In sententia continuata repetitum, Sive, Vel, Tam quàm, Cùm, Tum. כל אחד Unusquisque: אחדית Unitas, אחדים Unitates.
אחר Post, posteà. מאוחר Postpositum: מוקדם ומאוחר Praemissum & postpositum, id est, Hysteron proteron: אחריות Obligatio, Oppignoratio, Cautio de futuro damno.
אטו Cur, Quare, Quamobrem, Quid ita?
אי Ubi? interrogationibus inservit, & variis particulis jungitur: אי מנן Undenam? אי מתי Quousque? אי אלו Qua ista? אי מדין Undenam? איכדין Quomodo?
אי Non, per Apocopam pro אין, ut 1.Sam.21.8. in Hebraeo. Hinc אי אפשר Non est possibile, Impossibile: אי הכרח Non necessarium, Contingens.

אי Si, per Apocopam pro אין, אן, Chaldaicè pro Hebraeo אם. Hinc אי לימא Si dicendum, ubi לימא Talmudicè pro לאמור, ut est in Grammatica nostra Chaldaica. In sententia continuata repetitum, est Sive, Tam, quàm. אי בעיר אי גבר Sive bestia sive vir, Exod.19.13. in Targum Hierosolymitano, ubi Jonathan אין, Onkelos cum Hebr. אם.
איר Vapor, Exhalatio humida: item Festum, Dies festivus & solennis. Sic in posteriore Targum, יומא דאידא ליה Dies festus erat ipsi, Esth.1.3.
אירן Ille: איהי ואידי Ille, & ille, Uterque.

איך Quomodo, Qualiter, Sicut, Quemadmodum: איכא Ubi, ubinam? איכדין Quomodo? איכות Qualitas, Praedicamentum Qualitatis. In Elia: ספר מעט הכמות ורב האיכות Liber brevis quantitate, sed magnus qualitate.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew letters are doubtful at this scan resolution and are not marked individually; Hebrew readings should be checked against the original. The Greek-looking word after "ex" in the second entry is illegible. The Hebrew in several entries (אי, איהר, איך) may carry diacritics not visible here. "Confestim" in the second entry is read as printed; the first letter may be Co- or Con-. The top-left mark and the faint top-centre glyph are not printed text and were omitted.
